shloka_text: अथ लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा तत्र कालेन केनचित् । निद्रा समभवत्तीव्रा कुम्भकर्णस्य रूपिणी ।। 7.13.1 ।।
transliteration: atha lokeśvarotsṛṣṭā tatra kālena kenacit | nidrā samabhavattīvrā kumbhakarṇasya rūpiṇī || 7.13.1 ||
translation: अथ then, लोकेश्वरोत्सृष्टा sent forth by the Lord of the worlds, तत्र there, कालेन केनचित् after some time, निद्रा sleep, समभवत् arose, तीव्रा intense, कुम्भकर्णस्य of Kumbhakarna, रूपिणी embodied.
explanation: Then, after some time, an intense, embodied sleep, sent forth by the Lord of the worlds, arose there for Kumbhakarna.
comments: Overcome by his boon of sleep, Kumbhakarna has a vast dwelling built and sinks into his long slumber, while Ravana ravages the worlds, slaying gods and sages and laying waste their gardens -- Kubera sends a messenger urging him to abandon unrighteousness, recounting his own penance and friendship with Shiva -- enraged, Ravana slays the messenger, feeds him to the rakshasas, and sets out to make war on Kubera.

shloka_text: ततो भ्रातरमासीनं कुम्भकर्णो ऽब्रवीद्वचः । निद्रा मां बाधते राजन्कारयस्व ममालयम् ।। 7.13.2 ।।
transliteration: tato bhrātaramāsīnaṃ kumbhakarṇo 'bravīdvacaḥ | nidrā māṃ bādhate rājankārayasva mamālayam || 7.13.2 ||
translation: ततः then, भ्रातरम् to his brother, आसीनम् seated, कुम्भकर्णः Kumbhakarna, अब्रवीत् spoke, वचः words, निद्रा sleep, माम् me, बाधते afflicts, राजन् O King, कारयस्व cause to be built, मम my, आलयम् dwelling.
explanation: Then, Kumbhakarna spoke to his seated brother, saying, "O King, sleep afflicts me; please have a dwelling built for me."

shloka_text: विनियुक्तास्ततो राज्ञा शिल्पिनो विश्वकर्मवत् । विस्तीर्णं योजनं शुभ्रं ततो द्विगुणमायतम् ।। 7.13.3 ।।
transliteration: viniyuktāstato rājñā śilpino viśvakarmavat | vistīrṇaṃ yojanaṃ śubhraṃ tato dviguṇamāyatam || 7.13.3 ||
translation: विनियुक्ताः appointed, ततः then, राज्ञा by the king, शिल्पिनः artisans, विश्वकर्मवत् like Vishvakarma, विस्तीर्णम् wide, योजनम् a yojana, शुभ्रम् splendid, ततः from that, द्विगुणम् double, आयतम् long.
explanation: Then, artisans like Vishvakarma were appointed by the king to construct a splendid dwelling, one yojana wide and twice that in length.

shloka_text: दर्शनीयं निराबाधं कुम्भकर्णस्य चक्रिरे । स्फाटिकैः काञ्चनैश्चित्रैः स्तम्भैः सर्वत्र शोभितम् ।। 7.13.4 ।।
transliteration: darśanīyaṃ nirābādhaṃ kumbhakarṇasya cakrire | sphāṭikaiḥ kāñcanaiścitraiḥ stambhaiḥ sarvatra śobhitam || 7.13.4 ||
translation: दर्शनीयम् beautiful to behold, निराबाधम् unobstructed, कुम्भकर्णस्य for Kumbhakarna, चक्रिरे they made, स्फाटिकैः with crystal, काञ्चनैः with gold, चित्रैः variegated, स्तम्भैः with pillars, सर्वत्र everywhere, शोभितम् adorned.
explanation: They built for Kumbhakarna a beautiful and unobstructed dwelling, adorned everywhere with variegated pillars of crystal and gold.

shloka_text: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानं किङ्किणीजालकं तथा । दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तं वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् ।। 7.13.5 ।।
transliteration: vaiḍūryakṛtasopānaṃ kiṅkiṇījālakaṃ tathā | dāntatoraṇavinyastaṃ vajrasphaṭikavedikam || 7.13.5 ||
translation: वैडूर्यकृतसोपानं having steps made of lapis lazuli, किङ्किणीजालकं a network of small bells, तथा and, दान्ततोरणविन्यस्तं adorned with ivory archways, वज्रस्फटिकवेदिकम् having platforms of diamond and crystal.
explanation: The structure featured steps made of lapis lazuli, a network of small bells, ivory archways, and platforms of diamond and crystal.

shloka_text: मनोहरं सर्वसुखं कारयामास राक्षसः । सर्वत्र सुखदं नित्यं मेरोः पुण्यां गुहामिव ।। 7.13.6 ।।
transliteration: manoharaṃ sarvasukhaṃ kārayāmāsa rākṣasaḥ | sarvatra sukhadaṃ nityaṃ meroḥ puṇyāṃ guhāmiva || 7.13.6 ||
translation: मनोहरं charming, सर्वसुखं providing all comforts, कारयामास caused to be made, राक्षसः the demon, सर्वत्र everywhere, सुखदं giving comfort, नित्यं always, मेरोः of Mount Meru, पुण्यां sacred, गुहामिव like a cave.
explanation: The demon (Ravana) had a charming and universally comfortable dwelling built, which was always pleasant, like a sacred cave on Mount Meru.

shloka_text: तत्र निद्रां समाविष्टः कुम्भकर्णो महाबलः । बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि शयानो न प्रबुद्ध्यते ।। 7.13.7 ।।
transliteration: tatra nidrāṃ samāviṣṭaḥ kumbhakarṇo mahābalaḥ | bahūnyabdasahasrāṇi śayāno na prabuddhyate || 7.13.7 ||
translation: तत्र there, निद्रां sleep, समाविष्टः overcome by, कुम्भकर्णो Kumbhakarna, महाबलः the greatly powerful, बहून्यब्दसहस्राणि for many thousands of years, शयानो sleeping, न not, प्रबुद्ध्यते awakens.
explanation: There, the greatly powerful Kumbhakarna, overcome by sleep, remained sleeping for many thousands of years without awakening.

shloka_text: निद्राभिभूते तु तदा कुम्भकर्णे दशाननः । देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वान्सञ्जघ्ने हि निरङ्कुशः ।। 7.13.8 ।।
transliteration: nidrābhibhūte tu tadā kumbhakarṇe daśānanaḥ | devarṣiyakṣagandharvānsañjaghne hi niraṅkuśaḥ || 7.13.8 ||
translation: निद्राभिभूते when overcome by sleep, तु indeed, तदा then, कुम्भकर्णे Kumbhakarna, दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana), देवर्षियक्षगन्धर्वान् gods, sages, Yakshas, and Gandharvas, सञ्जघ्ने killed, हि indeed, निरङ्कुशः unrestrained.
explanation: When Kumbhakarna was overcome by sleep, the unrestrained Dashanana (Ravana) then indeed killed gods, sages, Yakshas, and Gandharvas.

shloka_text: उद्यानानि च चित्राणि नन्दनादीनि यानि च । तानि गत्वा सुसङक्रुद्धो भिनत्ति स्म दशाननः ।। 7.13.9 ।।
transliteration: udyānāni ca citrāṇi nandanādīni yāni ca | tāni gatvā susaṅakruddho bhinatti sma daśānanaḥ || 7.13.9 ||
translation: उद्यानानि gardens, च and, चित्राणि beautiful, नन्दनादीनि Nandana and others, यानि which, च and, तानि those, गत्वा having gone, सुसङक्रुद्धो very enraged, भिनत्ति broke, स्म (past tense indicator), दशाननः Dashanana (Ravana).
explanation: Dashanana (Ravana), having gone to those beautiful gardens, including Nandana and others, very enraged, proceeded to destroy them.

shloka_text: नदीं गज इव क्रीडन्वृक्षान्वायुरिव क्षिपन् । नगान्व्रज्र इवोत्सृष्टो विध्वंसयति राक्षसः ।। 7.13.10 ।।
transliteration: nadīṃ gaja iva krīḍanvṛkṣānvāyuriva kṣipan | nagānvrajra ivotsṛṣṭo vidhvaṃsayati rākṣasaḥ || 7.13.10 ||
translation: नदीं river, गज इव like an elephant, क्रीडन् playing, वृक्षान् trees, वायुर् इव like wind, क्षिपन् throwing down, नगान् mountains, व्रज्र इव like a thunderbolt, उत्सृष्टो hurled, विध्वंसयति destroys, राक्षसः the demon.
explanation: The demon destroys everything, playing with rivers like an elephant, throwing down trees like the wind, and shattering mountains like a hurled thunderbolt.

shloka_text: तथावृत्तं तु विज्ञाय दशग्रीवं धनेश्वरः । कुलानुरूपं धर्मज्ञो वृत्तं संस्मृत्य चात्मनः ।। 7.13.11 ।।
transliteration: tathāvṛttaṃ tu vijñāya daśagrīvaṃ dhaneśvaraḥ | kulānurūpaṃ dharmajño vṛttaṃ saṃsmṛtya cātmanaḥ || 7.13.11 ||
translation: तथावृत्तं such conduct, तु indeed, विज्ञाय having known, दशग्रीवं Daśagrīva's, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth (Kubera), कुलानुरूपं befitting the family, धर्मज्ञो knowing righteousness, वृत्तं conduct, संस्मृत्य having remembered, च and, आत्मनः his own.
explanation: Kubera, the lord of wealth and a knower of righteousness, having learned of Daśagrīva's conduct and remembering his own family's appropriate behavior, decided to act.

shloka_text: सौभ्रात्रदर्शनार्थं तु दूतं वैश्रवणस्तदा । लङ्कां सम्प्रेषयामास दशग्रीवस्य वै हितम् ।। 7.13.12 ।।
transliteration: saubhrātradarśanārthaṃ tu dūtaṃ vaiśravaṇastadā | laṅkāṃ sampreṣayāmāsa daśagrīvasya vai hitam || 7.13.12 ||
translation: सौभ्रात्रदर्शनार्थं for the sake of showing brotherly affection, तु indeed, दूतं a messenger, वैश्रवणस्तदा Vaiśravaṇa (Kubera) then, लङ्कां to Lanka, सम्प्रेषयामास sent, दशग्रीवस्य of Daśagrīva, वै indeed, हितम् beneficial.
explanation: Then, Kubera, wishing to demonstrate brotherly affection and for Daśagrīva's welfare, sent a messenger to Lanka.

shloka_text: स गत्वा नगरीं लङ्कामाससाद विभीषणम् । मानितस्तेन धर्मेण पृष्टश्चागमनं प्रति ।। 7.13.13 ।।
transliteration: sa gatvā nagarīṃ laṅkāmāsasāda vibhīṣaṇam | mānitastena dharmeṇa pṛṣṭaścāgamanaṃ prati || 7.13.13 ||
translation: स he (the messenger), गत्वा having gone, नगरीं to the city, लङ्कां Lanka, आससाद met, विभीषणम् Vibhīṣaṇa, मानितस्तेन honored by him, धर्मेण properly, पृष्टश्चागमनं and questioned about his arrival, प्रति regarding.
explanation: Having arrived in the city of Lanka, the messenger met Vibhīṣaṇa, who honored him properly and inquired about the purpose of his visit.

shloka_text: पृष्ट्वा च कुशलं राज्ञो ज्ञातीनां च बिभीषणः । सभायां दर्शयामास तमासीनं दशाननम् ।। 7.13.14 ।।
transliteration: pṛṣṭvā ca kuśalaṃ rājño jñātīnāṃ ca bibhīṣaṇaḥ | sabhāyāṃ darśayāmāsa tamāsīnaṃ daśānanam || 7.13.14 ||
translation: पृष्ट्वा having asked, च and, कुशलं welfare, राज्ञो of the king, ज्ञातीनां of the relatives, च and, बिभीषणः Vibhīṣaṇa, सभायां in the assembly, दर्शयामास showed, तमासीनं him seated, दशाननम् Daśānana (Rāvaṇa).
explanation: After inquiring about the welfare of the king and his relatives, Vibhīṣaṇa led the messenger to the assembly hall where Daśānana was seated.

shloka_text: स दृष्ट्वा तत्र राजानं दीप्यमानं स्वतेजसा । जयेति वाचा सम्पूज्य तूष्णीं समभिवर्तत ।। 7.13.15 ।।
transliteration: sa dṛṣṭvā tatra rājānaṃ dīpyamānaṃ svatejasā | jayeti vācā sampūjya tūṣṇīṃ samabhivartata || 7.13.15 ||
translation: स he (the messenger), दृष्ट्वा having seen, तत्र there, राजानं the king, दीप्यमानं shining, स्वतेजसा with his own splendor, जयेति "Victory!", वाचा with words, सम्पूज्य having honored, तूष्णीं silently, समभिवर्तत stood.
explanation: Upon seeing the king shining with his own splendor, the messenger honored him with words of "Victory!" and then stood silently.

shloka_text: तं तत्रोत्तमपर्यङ्के वरास्तरणशोभिते । उपविष्टं दशग्रीवं दूतो वाक्यमथाब्रवीत् ।। 7.13.16 ।।
transliteration: taṃ tatrottamaparyaṅke varāstaraṇaśobhite | upaviṣṭaṃ daśagrīvaṃ dūto vākyamathābravīt || 7.13.16 ||
translation: तम् him, तत्र there, उत्तमपर्यङ्के on an excellent couch, वरास्तरणशोभिते adorned with excellent coverings, उपविष्टम् seated, दशग्रीवम् Dashagriva (Ravana), दूतः the messenger, वाक्यम् words, अथ then, अब्रवीत् spoke.
explanation: The messenger then spoke words to Dashagriva, who was seated there on an excellent couch adorned with fine coverings.

shloka_text: राजन्वदामि ते सर्वं भ्राता तव यदब्रवीत् । उभयोः सदृशं वीर वृत्तस्य च कुलस्य च ।। 7.13.17 ।।
transliteration: rājanvadāmi te sarvaṃ bhrātā tava yadabravīt | ubhayoḥ sadṛśaṃ vīra vṛttasya ca kulasya ca || 7.13.17 ||
translation: राजन् O King, वदामि I tell, ते you, सर्वम् all, भ्राता brother, तव your, यत् what, अब्रवीत् spoke, उभयोः of both (of us), सदृशम् befitting, वीर O hero, वृत्तस्य of conduct, च and, कुलस्य of lineage, च and.
explanation: O King, I will tell you everything that your brother spoke, which is befitting of the conduct and lineage of both of us, O hero.

shloka_text: साधु पर्याप्तमेतावत्कृतश्चारित्रसङ्ग्रहः । साधु धर्मे व्यवस्थानं क्रियतां यदि शक्यते ।। 7.13.18 ।।
transliteration: sādhu paryāptametāvatkṛtaścāritrasaṅgrahaḥ | sādhu dharme vyavasthānaṃ kriyatāṃ yadi śakyate || 7.13.18 ||
translation: साधु enough, पर्याप्तम् enough, एतावत् this much, कृतः done, चारित्रसङ्ग्रहः accumulation of character (deeds), साधु proper, धर्मे in righteousness, व्यवस्थानम् adherence, क्रियताम् let it be done, यदि if, शक्यते it is possible.
explanation: Enough of this accumulation of deeds; it is proper that adherence to righteousness be established, if it is possible.

shloka_text: दृष्टं मे नन्दनं भग्नमृषयो निहताः श्रुताः । देवतानां समुद्योगस्त्वत्तो राजन्मम श्रुतः ।। 7.13.19 ।।
transliteration: dṛṣṭaṃ me nandanaṃ bhagnamṛṣayo nihatāḥ śrutāḥ | devatānāṃ samudyogastvatto rājanmama śrutaḥ || 7.13.19 ||
translation: दृष्टम् seen, मे by me, नन्दनम् Nandana (garden), भग्नम् destroyed, ऋषयः sages, निहताः killed, श्रुताः heard, देवतानाम् of the gods, समुद्योगः preparation, त्वत्तः from you, राजन् O King, मम by me, श्रुतः heard.
explanation: I have seen the Nandana garden destroyed, I have heard that sages were killed, and I have heard from you, O King, about the gods' preparations.

shloka_text: निराकृतश्च बहुशस्त्वया ऽहं राक्षसाधिप । अपराद्धा हि बाल्याच्च रमणीयाः स्वबान्धवाः ।। 7.13.20 ।।
transliteration: nirākṛtaśca bahuśastvayā 'haṃ rākṣasādhipa | aparāddhā hi bālyācca ramaṇīyāḥ svabāndhavāḥ || 7.13.20 ||
translation: निराकृतः rejected, च and, बहुशः many times, त्वया by you, अहम् I, राक्षसाधिप O lord of Rakshasas, अपराद्धाः those who have erred, हि indeed, बाल्यात् due to childishness, च and, रमणीयाः should be cherished, स्वबान्धवाः one's own relatives.
explanation: O lord of Rakshasas, I have been disregarded by you many times, yet one's own relatives, even if they have erred due to childishness, should indeed be cherished.

shloka_text: अहं तु हिमवत्पृष्ठं गतो धर्ममुपासितुम् । रौद्रं व्रत्तं समास्थाय नियतो नियतेन्द्रियः ।। 7.13.21 ।।
transliteration: ahaṃ tu himavatpṛṣṭhaṃ gato dharmamupāsitum | raudraṃ vrattaṃ samāsthāya niyato niyatendriyaḥ || 7.13.21 ||
translation: अहं I, तु indeed, हिमवत्पृष्ठं to the peak of Himavat, गतो went, धर्मम् dharma, उपासितुम् to practice, रौद्रं fierce, व्रत्तं vow, समास्थाय having undertaken, नियतः self-controlled, नियतेन्द्रियः with controlled senses.
explanation: I indeed went to the peak of the Himalayas to practice dharma, having undertaken a severe vow, disciplined and with my senses controlled.

shloka_text: तत्र देवो मया दृष्टः सह देव्या मया प्रभुः । सव्यं चक्षुर्मया दैवात्तत्र देव्यां निपातितम् ।। 7.13.22 ।।
transliteration: tatra devo mayā dṛṣṭaḥ saha devyā mayā prabhuḥ | savyaṃ cakṣurmayā daivāttatra devyāṃ nipātitam || 7.13.22 ||
translation: तत्र there, देवः the god, मया by me, दृष्टः was seen, सह with, देव्या the goddess, मया by me, प्रभुः the lord, सव्यं left, चक्षुः eye, मया by me, दैवात् by chance, तत्र there, देव्यां on the goddess, निपातितम् was cast.
explanation: There, I saw the Lord, the god Shiva, with the goddess Parvati, and by chance, my left eye fell upon the goddess.

shloka_text: का न्वियं स्यादिति शुभा न खल्वन्येन हेतुना । रूपं ह्यनुपमं कृत्वा रुद्राणी तत्र तिष्ठति ।। 7.13.23 ।।
transliteration: kā nviyaṃ syāditi śubhā na khalvanyena hetunā | rūpaṃ hyanupamaṃ kṛtvā rudrāṇī tatra tiṣṭhati || 7.13.23 ||
translation: का who, नु indeed, इयं this, स्यात् might be, इति thus, शुभा beautiful one, न not, खलु indeed, अन्येन by another, हेतुना reason, रूपं form, हि indeed, अनुपमं incomparable, कृत्वा having assumed, रुद्राणी Rudra's consort, तत्र there, तिष्ठति stands.
explanation: I wondered, "Who might this beautiful one be?" and not for any other reason, for Rudra's consort, Parvati, stood there having assumed an incomparable form.

shloka_text: देव्या दिव्यप्रभावेण दग्धं सव्यं ममेक्षणम् । रेणुध्वस्तमिव ज्योतिः पिङ्गुलत्वमुपागतम् ।। 7.13.24 ।।
transliteration: devyā divyaprabhāveṇa dagdhaṃ savyaṃ mamekṣaṇam | reṇudhvastamiva jyotiḥ piṅgulatvamupāgatam || 7.13.24 ||
translation: देव्या by the goddess, दिव्यप्रभावेण by divine power, दग्धं burnt, सव्यं left, मम my, ईक्षणम् eye, रेणुध्वस्तम् dust-covered, इव like, ज्योतिः light, पिङ्गुलत्वम् yellowish-brown color, उपागतम् attained.
explanation: By the divine power of the goddess, my left eye was burnt, and it became yellowish-brown, like a flame obscured by dust.

shloka_text: ततो ऽहमन्यद्विस्तीर्णं गत्वा तस्य गिरेस्तटम् । तूष्णीं वर्षशतान्यष्टौ समाधारं महाव्रतम् ।। 7.13.25 ।।
transliteration: tato 'hamanyadvistīrṇaṃ gatvā tasya girestaṭam | tūṣṇīṃ varṣaśatānyaṣṭau samādhāraṃ mahāvratam || 7.13.25 ||
translation: ततः then, अहं I, अन्यत् another, विस्तीर्णं expansive, गत्वा having gone, तस्य of that, गिरेः mountain's, तटम् slope, तूष्णीं silently, वर्षशतानि hundreds of years, अष्टौ eight, समाधारं observed, महाव्रतम् great vow.
explanation: Then, I went to another expansive slope of that mountain and silently observed a great vow for eight hundred years.

shloka_text: समाप्ते नियमे तस्मिंस्तत्र देवो महेश्वरः । प्रीतः प्रीतेन मनसा प्राह वाक्यमिदं प्रभुः ।। 7.13.26 ।।
transliteration: samāpte niyame tasmiṃstatra devo maheśvaraḥ | prītaḥ prītena manasā prāha vākyamidaṃ prabhuḥ || 7.13.26 ||
translation: तस्मिन् that, नियमे vow, समाप्ते when completed, तत्र there, प्रभुः the lord, देवो महेश्वरः god Maheshvara, प्रीतः pleased, प्रीतेन मनसा with a gladdened mind, इदं वाक्यं these words, प्राह spoke.
explanation: When that austerity was completed, the lord Maheshvara, well pleased, spoke these words there with a gladdened mind.

shloka_text: पैङ्गल्यं यदवाप्तं हि देव्या रूपनिरीक्षणात् । प्रीतो ऽस्मि तव धर्मज्ञ तपसा नेन सुव्रत ।। 7.13.27 ।।
transliteration: paiṅgalyaṃ yadavāptaṃ hi devyā rūpanirīkṣaṇāt | prīto 'smi tava dharmajña tapasā nena suvrata || 7.13.27 ||
translation: पैङ्गल्यं yellowness, यत् which, अवाप्तं obtained, हि indeed, देव्या by the goddess, रूपनिरीक्षणात् from seeing (her) form, प्रीतो ऽस्मि I am pleased, तव your, धर्मज्ञ O knower of dharma, तपसा by penance, अनेन by this, सुव्रत O one of good vows.
explanation: O knower of dharma, O one of good vows, I am indeed pleased by this penance of yours, which resulted in the yellowness (of your eye) from gazing upon the goddess's form.

shloka_text: मया चैतद्व्रतं चीर्णं त्वया चैव धनाधिप । तृतीयः पुरुषो नास्ति यश्चरेव्रतमीदृशम् ।। 7.13.28 ।।
transliteration: mayā caitadvrataṃ cīrṇaṃ tvayā caiva dhanādhipa | tṛtīyaḥ puruṣo nāsti yaścarevratamīdṛśam || 7.13.28 ||
translation: मया च and by me, एतद् व्रतं this vow, चीर्णं performed, त्वया च एव and by you alone, धनाधिप O lord of wealth, तृतीयः a third, पुरुषो person, न अस्ति there is not, यः who, चरेत् would perform, व्रतम् a vow, ईदृशम् such.
explanation: O lord of wealth, this vow has been performed by me and by you alone, for there is no third person who could perform such a vow.

shloka_text: व्रतं सुनिश्चयं ह्येतन्मया ह्युत्पादितं पुरा । तत्सखित्वं मया सौम्य रोचयस्व धनेश्वर ।। 7.13.29 ।।
transliteration: vrataṃ suniścayaṃ hyetanmayā hyutpāditaṃ purā | tatsakhitvaṃ mayā saumya rocayasva dhaneśvara || 7.13.29 ||
translation: व्रतं vow, सुनिश्चयं very firm, हि indeed, एतत् this, मया हि indeed by me, उत्पादितं originated, पुरा formerly, तत् therefore, सखित्वं friendship, मया with me, सौम्य O gentle one, रोचयस्व desire, धनेश्वर O lord of wealth.
explanation: This very firm vow was indeed originated by me in the past, therefore, O gentle lord of wealth, desire friendship with me.

shloka_text: तपसा निर्जितश्चैव सखा भव ममानघ । देव्या दग्धं प्रभावेण यच्च सव्यं तवेक्षणम् ।। 7.13.30 ।।
transliteration: tapasā nirjitaścaiva sakhā bhava mamānagha | devyā dagdhaṃ prabhāveṇa yacca savyaṃ tavekṣaṇam || 7.13.30 ||
translation: तपसा by penance, निर्जितः च एव conquered and indeed, सखा friend, भव become, मम my, अनघ O sinless one, देव्या by the goddess, दग्धं burnt, प्रभावेण by the power, यत् च and which, सव्यं left, तव your, ईक्षणम् eye.
explanation: O sinless one, having been conquered by your penance, become my friend, especially since your left eye was burnt by the power of the goddess.

shloka_text: एकाक्षिपिङ्गलेत्येव नाम स्थास्यति शाश्वतम् । एवं तेन सखित्वं च प्राप्यानुज्ञां च शङ्करात् ।। 7.13.31 ।।
transliteration: ekākṣipiṅgaletyeva nāma sthāsyati śāśvatam | evaṃ tena sakhitvaṃ ca prāpyānujñāṃ ca śaṅkarāt || 7.13.31 ||
translation: एकाक्षिपिङ्गलेति Ekakshipingala, एव indeed, नाम name, स्थास्यति will remain, शाश्वतम् eternal, एवम् thus, तेन by him, सखित्वम् friendship, च and, प्राप्य having obtained, अनुज्ञाम् permission, च and, शङ्करात् from Shankara.
explanation: Thus, the name Ekakshipingala will remain eternal, and having obtained friendship and permission from Lord Shankara, Kubera spoke.

shloka_text: आगत्य च श्रुतो ऽयं मे तव पापविनिश्चयः ।। 7.13.32 ।।
transliteration: āgatya ca śruto 'yaṃ me tava pāpaviniścayaḥ || 7.13.32 ||
translation: आगत्य having come, च and, श्रुतः heard, अयम् this, मे by me, तव your, पापविनिश्चयः sinful resolve.
explanation: And having come here, I have heard of this sinful resolve of yours.

shloka_text: तदधर्मिष्ठसंयोगान्निवर्त कुलदूषणात् । चिन्त्यते हि वधोपायः सर्षिसङ्घैः सुरैस्तव ।। 7.13.33 ।।
transliteration: tadadharmiṣṭhasaṃyogānnivarta kuladūṣaṇāt | cintyate hi vadhopāyaḥ sarṣisaṅghaiḥ suraistava || 7.13.33 ||
translation: तत् therefore, अधर्मिष्ठसंयोगात् from unrighteous union, निवर्त turn back, कुलदूषणात् from disgracing your family, चिन्त्यते is being thought of, हि indeed, वधोपायः means of killing, सर्षिसङ्घैः by the sages along with their groups, सुरैः by the gods, तव your.
explanation: Therefore, desist from this unrighteous union which disgraces your family, for indeed, the gods along with the groups of sages are contemplating a means to kill you.

shloka_text: एवमुक्तो दशग्रीवः क्रुद्धसंरक्तलोचनः । हस्तौ दन्तांश्च सम्पीड्य वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। 7.13.34 ।।
transliteration: evamukto daśagrīvaḥ kruddhasaṃraktalocanaḥ | hastau dantāṃśca sampīḍya vākyametaduvāca ha || 7.13.34 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्तः spoken to, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, क्रुद्धसंरक्तलोचनः with eyes red with anger, हस्तौ hands, दन्तान् teeth, च and, सम्पीड्य having pressed/gnashed, वाक्यम् words, एतत् these, उवाच spoke, ह indeed.
explanation: Thus addressed, Dashagriva, with eyes red with anger, gnashed his teeth and spoke these words.

shloka_text: विज्ञातं ते मया दूत वाक्यं यस्य प्रभाषसे । नैतत्त्वमसि नैवासौ भ्रात्रा येनासि चोदितः ।। 7.13.35 ।।
transliteration: vijñātaṃ te mayā dūta vākyaṃ yasya prabhāṣase | naitattvamasi naivāsau bhrātrā yenāsi coditaḥ || 7.13.35 ||
translation: विज्ञातम् understood, ते your, मया by me, दूत O messenger, वाक्यम् words, यस्य whose, प्रभाषसे you speak, न not, एतत् this, त्वम् you, असि are, न not, एव indeed, असौ he, भ्रात्रा by the brother, येन by whom, असि you are, चोदितः instigated.
explanation: O messenger, I have understood your words which you speak and whose message it is; you are not this person, nor is he the brother by whom you claim to be instigated.

shloka_text: हितं नैष ममैतद्धि ब्रवीति धनरक्षकः । महेश्वरसखित्वं तु मूढ श्रावयते किल ।। 7.13.36 ।।
transliteration: hitaṃ naiṣa mamaitaddhi bravīti dhanarakṣakaḥ | maheśvarasakhitvaṃ tu mūḍha śrāvayate kila || 7.13.36 ||
translation: हितं beneficial, न not, एष this (one), मम my, एतत् this, हि indeed, ब्रवीति speaks, धनरक्षकः the protector of wealth (Kubera), महेश्वरसखित्वं friendship with Maheśvara (Shiva), तु but, मूढ foolish one, श्रावयते makes (me) hear, किल indeed.
explanation: This protector of wealth (Kubera) is not speaking what is beneficial for me; rather, this fool is indeed making me hear about his friendship with Maheśvara.

shloka_text: न चेदं क्षमणीयं मे यदेतद्भाषितं त्वया । यदेतावन्मया कालं दूत तस्य तु मर्षितम् ।। 7.13.37 ।।
transliteration: na cedaṃ kṣamaṇīyaṃ me yadetadbhāṣitaṃ tvayā | yadetāvanmayā kālaṃ dūta tasya tu marṣitam || 7.13.37 ||
translation: न not, च and, इदं this, क्षमणीयं to be forgiven, मे by me, यत् that which, एतत् this, भाषितं spoken, त्वया by you, यत् that which, एतावत् so much, मया by me, कालं time, दूत O messenger, तस्य his, तु but, मर्षितम् endured.
explanation: O messenger, what you have spoken is not to be forgiven by me, though I have endured his (Kubera's) actions for so long.

shloka_text: न हन्तव्यो गुरुर्ज्येष्ठो मया ऽयमिति मन्यते । तस्य त्विदानीं श्रुत्वा मे वाक्यमेषा कृता मतिः ।। 7.13.38 ।।
transliteration: na hantavyo gururjyeṣṭho mayā 'yamiti manyate | tasya tvidānīṃ śrutvā me vākyameṣā kṛtā matiḥ || 7.13.38 ||
translation: न not, हन्तव्यो to be killed, गुरुः preceptor, ज्येष्ठो elder brother, मया by me, अयं this (one), इति thus, मन्यते (he) thinks, तस्य his, तु but, इदानीं now, श्रुत्वा having heard, मे my, वाक्यं word, एषा this, कृता made, मतिः decision.
explanation: He (Kubera) thinks that this elder brother, my preceptor, should not be killed by me, but having now heard my words, this decision has been made by me.

shloka_text: त्रीँल्लोकानपि जेष्यामि बाहुवीर्यमुपाश्रितः ।। 7.13.39 ।।
transliteration: trīँllokānapi jeṣyāmi bāhuvīryamupāśritaḥ || 7.13.39 ||
translation: त्रीँल् three, लोकान् worlds, अपि even, जेष्यामि I shall conquer, बाहुवीर्यम् strength of arms, उपाश्रितः having resorted to.
explanation: Relying on the strength of my arms, I shall conquer even the three worlds.

shloka_text: एतन्मुहूर्तमेवाहं तस्यैकस्य तु वै कृते । चतुरो लोकपालांस्तान्नयिष्यामि यमक्षयम् ।। 7.13.40 ।।
transliteration: etanmuhūrtamevāhaṃ tasyaikasya tu vai kṛte | caturo lokapālāṃstānnayiṣyāmi yamakṣayam || 7.13.40 ||
translation: एतत् this, मुहूर्तम् moment, एव only, अहं I, तस्य his, एकस्य one (Kubera's), तु but, वै indeed, कृते for the sake of, चतुरो four, लोकपालांस् world-protectors, तान् those, नयिष्यामि I shall lead, यमक्षयम् to Yama's abode.
explanation: Indeed, for the sake of that one (Kubera) alone, I shall, in this very moment, lead those four world-protectors to Yama's abode.

shloka_text: एवमुक्त्वा तु लङ्केशो दूतं खड्गेन जघ्निवान् । ददौ भक्षयितुं ह्येनं राक्षसानां दुरात्मनाम् ।। 7.13.41 ।।
transliteration: evamuktvā tu laṅkeśo dūtaṃ khaḍgena jaghnivān | dadau bhakṣayituṃ hyenaṃ rākṣasānāṃ durātmanām || 7.13.41 ||
translation: एवम् thus, उक्त्वा having said, तु indeed, लङ्केशो the lord of Lanka (Ravana), दूतं the messenger, खड्गेन with a sword, जघ्निवान् killed, ददौ gave, भक्षयितुं to devour, हि indeed, एनं him, राक्षसानां to the Rākṣasas, दुरात्मनाम् wicked.
explanation: Having spoken thus, Ravana, the lord of Lanka, killed the messenger with his sword and gave him to the wicked Rākṣasas to be devoured.

shloka_text: एवं कृतस्वस्त्ययनो रथमारुह्य रावणः । त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी ययौ यत्र धनेश्वरः ।। 7.13.42 ।।
transliteration: evaṃ kṛtasvastyayano rathamāruhya rāvaṇaḥ | trailokyavijayākāṅkṣī yayau yatra dhaneśvaraḥ || 7.13.42 ||
translation: एवं thus, कृतस्वस्त्ययनो one who had performed auspicious rites, रथम् chariot, आरुह्य having ascended, रावणः Ravana, त्रैलोक्यविजयाकाङ्क्षी desirous of conquering the three worlds, ययौ went, यत्र where, धनेश्वरः the lord of wealth.
explanation: Having thus performed auspicious rites and mounted his chariot, Ravana, desirous of conquering the three worlds, went to where Kubera, the lord of wealth, resided. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्रयोदशः सर्गः ।। 13 ।। Thus ends the thirteenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
